acceptance.baseline_selection: strongest eligible development baseline; freeze pipeline/config before holdout
acceptance.comparison: strict overall nDCG improvement; no per-slice nDCG/task regression
acceptance.execution: zero errors, degraded, forbidden, missing telemetry or unfulfilled requested reranking

corpus_scope: Synthetic mail/calendar/files/chat retrieval with hard distractors across all splits; engineering labels, no parity/scale/ACL/ingestion claim.
evidence_scope: Relevance judged against complete source bodies. evidence.jsonl contains sealed holdout judgments; do not inspect while tuning. This harness scores IDs and cannot establish returned snippet sufficiency, full-body reranker exposure, candidate recall, or answer faithfulness.
label_status: synthetic engineering labels; independent domain adjudication pending

splits.holdout: sealed until implementation/model/config/source freeze; first final run only; never tune on results
